scope: Bounded local GIF/APNG/animated-WebP frame sampling; not complete video or classifier acceptance.

Partial negative-only samples stay uncertain; actual positive evidence dominates without claiming unsampled frames safe. Worker per-attachment bounds and aggregate four-attachment bounds are independently validated.
Chat gate displays sampled-versus-total counts with an explicit unsampled-frame warning. Existing pinned local models and assets are retained; no remote plaintext classifier is added.
